Debate over funding for cow urine research amid scarce funds

Questions have been raised regarding the allocation of research funds towards studies on cow urine, particularly when overall research budgets are limited. This debate highlights concerns about scientific priorities and the efficient use of public money in India's research sector. The issue brings into focus the broader challenges faced by scientific funding and research direction within the country.
